newsitem.title: JAPAN: Iran keeps April Asia crude formula steady-traders.
newsitem.headline: Iran keeps April Asia crude formula steady-traders.

text.p: State-owned National Iranian Oil Co (NIOC) will keep its April crude pricing formula for Iranian Light crude and Iranian Heavy crude unchanged from March, traders in Tokyo said on Wednesday.
This means that Iranian Light for April-loading will be priced at Oman's MPM minus seven cents per barrel, with an automatic adjustment factor added to that.
The formula for Iranian Heavy remains at Dubai quotations minus 13 cents per barrel, with an automatic adjustment factor then subtracted.
The price of Iranian Light crude is linked to Saudi Arabia's Arab Light crude, while Iranian Heavy crude moves in tandem with Arab Medium crude.
Iranian crude prices are set on a quarterly basis.
However, under a contract agreement, NIOC and its customers can review prices whenever Saudi Arabian crude prices move substantially.
